This video shows the sizes of some of the most well-known aliens in fiction, ranging from microscopic sizes to colossal creatures.

► Due to the large number of aliens in fiction, only a few representative examples have been selected; many have been discarded. You can see the list at the end or watch this video which shows other examples of monsters: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OKoF4l68qW4

► Note: Creatures from Earth, fantasy worlds, mythology, and deities are not included. Extraterrestrials with a human appearance, synthetic or robotic beings are also excluded.

~ - Approximate
± - Error range
*UM - Unreliable Measure
White texts have sources
Yellow texts are MBS estimates
